title: Presidential candidates ramp up street campaigning this weekend
subtitle: Candidates prioritized walks and motorcades through the interior and capitals on the final weekend before the first round.
excerpt: On the final weekend before the first round, presidential candidates held walks and motorcades in cities across the country.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the final weekend before the first round of the elections, the presidential candidates focused their efforts on the streets. Their schedules featured walks and motorcades that spanned both the interior and capital cities.

Campaign activities

The candidates organized mobile events, taking advantage of the approaching first round to strengthen their physical presence among the electorate. The walks and motorcades took place across different regions, allowing direct contact with voters in both urban and rural areas.

  • Events held in state interiors
  • Motorcades in capital cities
  • A focus on mobilizing voters ahead of the election

These initiatives reinforce the campaign strategy of bringing candidates directly to the people, highlighting the importance of a physical presence on public streets during the election period.

With information from Agência Brasil.
